cache.catalog-api.config:
Catalog API response cache configuration. Project: catalog-api. Approved contract for cache settings.

```json
{
  "project": "catalog-api",
  "cache": {
    "ttl_seconds": 300,
    "max_entries": 1000,
    "eviction_policy": "lru",
    "namespace": "catalog-shared",
    "cache_misses": false
  }
}
```

Field notes: ttl_seconds=300 (not conventional 60/3600), max_entries=1000, eviction_policy=lru, namespace=catalog-shared, cache_misses=false (boolean). All values are as supplied in the approved decision; no defaults were substituted.
